# A hidden floating child stays mounted after its parent removes its DOM

## Context

`test/playwright/component/menu/SpawnAnimation.spec.mjs` "a dismissed and reopened instance is cleaned up and re-arms" flakes the `components (3/3)` shard. The reopened menu stays `unaligned`: the node is present but has no `neo-aligned-*` class for 5 s. It failed on `#19964` (job 119302098063) and `#19970` (job 119479884524), and `components (3/3)` failed in 3 of the 6 `dev` runs before `0c7ccd5878`. Locally it reproduces 1/30 serially, and 3/60 under 6 workers with a probe that replays the arm.

The probe timelines (App worker clock, `Neo.menu.List#afterSetMounted` / `alignTo` hooks plus the update batches):

- **Passing:** the hide's viewport batch removes the menu node. A deferred `List.unmount()` (`src/menu/List.mjs`) then sets `mounted: false` about 68 ms later. On the reopen batch, the viewport's landing mounts the menu again → `afterSetMounted(true)` → `alignTo()` → `DomAccess.align` with the node present.
- **Failing:** the reopen batch follows the hide's 9 ms later, before the deferred unmount. The menu still reads `mounted: true`, so the reopen is no transition: no `afterSetMounted(true)`, no `alignTo()`, and the new node never aligns.

## The Problem

The arm's menu is a floating ITEM of the viewport container (`parentId: 'component-test-viewport'`), rendered inside the viewport's node. Hiding it runs `Component#hide()`'s non-body branch (`vdom.removeDom = true` + `parent.update()`). The parent's landing removes the node, but `VdomLifecycle#unmountRemovedChildren` skips floating children, so the menu keeps `mounted: true` with no DOM until something else unmounts it. During that window it breaks the engine's contract: a component without DOM reports mounted. Its updates can still fly and produce deltas for a missing node, and a show inside the window gets no mount hooks (alignment, `focusOnMount`, the outside-pointer listener). The same holds for any floating component hidden inside a parent, not just menus (inferred from the code path; measured only for the menu).

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs` `unmountRemovedChildren()` unmounts children absent from the synced tree, except `child.floating`. Its JSDoc gives the reason: "Floating children (dialogs, popups) render outside their parent's node and are never tested."
- That reason does not hold for a floating child added as an item: it renders inside its parent's node, and its own `removeDom` is what took the node out.
- `component.Base#hide()` for a parent other than `document.body` never calls `unmount()`. `#18290` recorded this ("mounted stays TRUE for a hidden floating menu") and keyed its focus guard on `hidden` instead.
- **Design authority:** the same JSDoc says "`mounted` is state tracking, not a DOM operation: the node is already gone, this records it." A floating child whose own `vdom.removeDom` removed it is exactly such a gone node.

## The Fix

In `unmountRemovedChildren()`, test a floating child too when its own vdom carries `removeDom`: `!child.floating || child.vdom.removeDom`. A hidden floating child is then unmounted by the landing that removed it, and its next show mounts it again with every mount hook. Floating children that render elsewhere and are not hidden stay untested, as before. The JSDoc names the exception.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A floating child hidden (`removeDom`) through its parent's update is `mounted: false` once that update lands, and showing it again runs its `afterSetMounted(true)`.
- [ ] AC-2: A floating menu shown again right after its removal (before any deferred unmount) is aligned (`neo-aligned-*`).
- [ ] AC-3: A unit arm for AC-1 and a component-tier browser arm for AC-2 are red on base and green at head.
- [ ] AC-4: Under the probe's load (6 workers), `SpawnAnimation.spec.mjs` "a dismissed and reopened instance is cleaned up and re-arms" passes every run at head (240 runs). This is an outside-CI receipt.
  - *Corrected before the PR:* this AC first also required base to fail under that load. Base passed 240/240 at `0c7ccd5878`. The natural failure is observed in CI (`#19970`, job 119479884524) and was reproduced locally only on the pre-`#19967` engine (1/30 serial, 3/60 in the probe). AC-2's deterministic arm carries the red-on-base proof.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] `components (3/3)` on `dev` shows no `SpawnAnimation.spec.mjs` "unaligned" failure over the next 10 runs.
